lines.text: The coldest thing ever reported was made by dropping it.
In 2021, physicists in Germany took about a hundred thousand atoms of rubidium.
They dropped them down a tower a hundred and ten metres high.
They watched the cloud during two seconds of free fall.
Without a trick, the cloud thinned out so fast that it couldn't be detected after about a sixth of a second.
With it, they could see the cloud for the whole fall.
Absolute zero is minus two hundred and seventy-three point one five degrees, and nothing has ever got there.
So how close did they get? The full video starts there, and it's linked right here.
